_comment: Who may show the verified badge, which identifier namespaces each of them owns, and the
GitHub account the pack repository must belong to.
`github.id` is the ONLY identity key. It is the numeric account id returned by the GitHub
API; it survives renames and cannot be copied by a lookalike login. `github.handle` is
display text for the operator and reviewers — validate.py never compares it.
`namespaces` makes the author/namespace relation hold in BOTH directions: an entry under
`run.vineyard.*` must be authored by VINEYARD, and an entry claiming VINEYARD must be
validate.py additionally resolves each listed author's `repo` through the GitHub API and
requires repo.owner.id == github.id. Without that, a stranger could publish
`run.vineyard.pluginpacks.fake` with `author: VINEYARD` from their own repository and the
two strings above would still match.
Whether an author really controls the DOMAIN behind a namespace is still a review
question; GitHub repository ownership is now checked automatically.
Submitters never edit this file. A PR that touches it is a governance change, not a listing.
